text:
Nora Patel: Oncall flagged that in the error drilldown the corr id and export action are hard to find. Current design hides corr id as tiny text and export is in the kebab. Can we surface both?

Diego Rivera: Yes. Corr id should be copyable with a one-click icon. Export should be a visible CTA in the header (not buried).

Keiko Sato: I mocked a compact header: corr id left with copy icon, title center, actions right. Export is a secondary button labeled 'Export' on desktop, icon-only on mobile with tooltip. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/trace-tools

Owen Brooks: Implementation: prefer a flyout (fast) over a modal for options. Defaults: include trace+logs. Flyout can have toggles for 'Include stack traces' and 'Redact sensitive fields'.

Priya Nair: Accessibility: copy button needs aria-label="Copy correlation ID", focus styles, and "Copied!" feedback. Export flyout must be keyboard accessible, trap focus, and provide an aria-live region for export progress. Add keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E to open flyout when trace has focus.

Diego Rivera: Filename pattern: <traceid>_<corrid>_<ts>.zip. Backend will return a signed URL via POST /api/v1/traces/{id}/export -> 202 + job_id; poll GET /api/v1/exports/{job_id}.

Nora Patel: Microcopy for flyout header: 'Download a bundle of the trace, logs, and related metadata.' Primary action text: 'Download' and helper text: 'Bundle includes trace.json, logs, and metadata.' Also add a privacy note: 'Files may include PII.'

Keiko Sato: I'll update the frames with accessible colors and the persistent "Copied!" tooltip for 1.5s. Also support responsive collapse to icon-only.

Owen Brooks: Server note: redaction option adds small generation time (~100ms); we'll include MD5 checksum inside the bundle.

accessibility-bot: Reminder: design changes require accessibility signoff. Ensure contrast >=4.5 for small text and ARIA attributes documented.
notes: Decisions: surface corr id with copy button, visible Export CTA (labelled desktop, icon mobile), use compact flyout for options including redact toggle, keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E, aria-live for progress, filename pattern <traceid>_<corrid>_<ts>.zip. Owners: Nora (follow-up), Keiko (design), Diego (backend), Owen (server).
